translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Weche mag Ruoth Lemuel, ma gin weche matut ma min mare nopuonje.

content.text: Yaye wuoda, yaye wuoda mane anywolo!
Winja, in wuoda mane anywolo
bangʼ ka Nyasaye osewinjo lemo mane atimonego singruok.
Kik iket tekri kuom mon,
kata nyalo mari kuom jogo maketho ruodhi.
Ok en gima owinjore ne ruodhi, yaye Lemuel,
mondo ruodhi omadh math makech,
kata jotelo ogomb kongʼo gi chunygi duto,
nono ka gimetho to wigi diwil gi gima chik ochiko,
ma gihiny joma ok nyal ka gitamogi e ratichgi.
Chiw kongʼo ne jogo ma chunygi ool,
to math makech ne jogo ma chunygi lit.
Wegi mondo gimethi mondo wigi owil gi chan-gi
kendo kik gichak gipar chandruokgi kendo.
Wuo ka ichwako joma ok nyal wacho wachgi gin giwegi,
ka ichwako jogo maonge nyalo.
Wuo kendo ngʼad bura kare,
chwak ratich jogo ma jochan kod jogo mochando.
Dhako ma kite longʼo en ngʼa manyalo nwangʼo?
Nengone oloyo kite ma nengogi tek.
Chwore ogenogo chutho
kendo onge gima oreme.
Okelone mana ber,
ok hinyruok ndalo duto mar ngimane.
Oyiero yie rombe kod tworo
kendo otiyo matek gi lwete.
Ochalo gi yiedhi mag ohala,
kokelo chiemo moa kuma bor.
Ochiewo aa e nindo ka pod piny mudho,
ochiwo chiemo ne joode to moko omiyo nyiri matiyone.
Omanyo puodho maber mi ongʼiew,
kendo kuom ohala moloko opidhogo puothe mag olembe.
Otiyo tijene gi teko duto;
kendo oratego e tije motiyo.
Oneno ni gik moloso miye ohala
to tache ok tho gotieno.
Ei lwete otingʼo yie rombe
kendo omako gir chwecho gi lith lwetene.
Oyawo bade ne joma jochan
kendo otero lwete ne jogo mochando.
Ka piny ngʼich, oonge luoro ne joode,
nikech giduto girwakore gi nengni mapichni.
Oloso raum ne kitandane,
orwakore gi lewni marep-rep maralik ma nengogi tek.
Chwore imiyo luor e dhoranga dala maduongʼ,
kama obedoe e dier jodongo mag gwengʼ.
Oloso lewni marep-rep mi ousgi,
kendo omiyo johala gik moko.
Orwakore gi teko kod dimbruok;
omiyo onyalo bedo mamor e ndalo mabiro.
Owuoyo gi rieko
kendo puonj mar adiera ni e lewe.
Orito weche mag ode
to ok ocham chiemb mifwadhi.
Nyithinde chungo kendo luonge ni en ngʼat mogwedhi,
chwore bende pake, kawacho niya,
“Mon mangʼeny timo gik mabeyo,
to in iloyogi duto.”
Ber mar wangʼ wuondo ji, to chia bende rumo;
to dhako moluoro Jehova Nyasaye yudo pak.
Miye pak moromo kode mondo onwangʼ
kendo we mondo tijene okelne pak e dhorangach mar dala maduongʼ.
